designationHistory.indexText: President Taft set apart the Okanogan National Forest in Washington from part of the Chelan National Forest.

designationHistory.indexText: President Wilson transferred the whole Okanogan National Forest to the Chelan National Forest, and the Okanogan name was dropped.
designationHistory.note: The order text was not located online; FS-612 and the WPA list agree on EO 3380 of Dec. 31, 1920, and Davis gives the effective date, July 1, 1921.

designationHistory.name: Chelan National Forest
designationHistory.indexText: The Department of the Interior, on the Secretary of Agriculture's recommendation, changed the name of the Chelan National Forest to the Okanogan National Forest.
designationHistory.note: Signed by Orme Lewis, Assistant Secretary of the Interior, under presidential authority delegated by EO 10355. The order says the Chelan National Forest was established by EO 823 of June 18, 1908.
